import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("/home/lhl/gfx1100-24gb-capacity")
local = Path("/tmp/xtx-capacity")
summary_path = local / "dms-int8-requested-75k-74k-72k.json"
assert not summary_path.exists(), "preserve previous ladder"
results = []
for tokens in (76800, 75776, 73728):
    print(f"START prompt_tokens={tokens}, decode_steps=8", flush=True)
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(local / "run_dms_edge.py"), str(tokens)], cwd=root
    )
    if completed.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)
    point = json.loads((local / f"dms-int8-edge-{tokens}.monitor.json").read_text())
    assert point["returns_to_baseline"]
    results.append(point)
    summary_path.write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    print(f"RESULT prompt_tokens={tokens}: {point['status']}", flush=True)
    if point["status"] == "execution_fit":
        break
    assert point["status"] == "oom", "do not classify other failures as capacity limits"
    subprocess.run(["rocm-smi", "--showmeminfo", "vram", "--showuse"], check=True)
print(f"LADDER_DONE: {len(results)} attempts; {results[-1]['status']}", flush=True)

hardware.other_workloads: GPU0 not used by these probes; GPU1 idle baseline verified per attempt

history_and_model_geometry.current_route_difference: DMS prefill uses BF16 full-history storage, then allocates compact INT8 destination before releasing dense storage
history_and_model_geometry.geometry_scope: full-attention payload per retained token at the same KV codec; excludes weights, recurrent state, metadata, allocator overhead and prefill workspaces
history_and_model_geometry.historical_model: same Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M file, not Q4_K_S; sampled fingerprint and tensor inventory matched in the controls audit
history_and_model_geometry.historical_route: long no-mirror INT8 C1, MTP/prefix off, explicit unverified-long gate; bounded quality scope
history_and_model_geometry.regression_conclusion: historical higher execution capacity is real for the same model/quant; current routes differ, so a matched old-route/current-tree rerun is needed before attributing a specific regression

limitations: Sampled whole-card peaks are lower bounds on instantaneous peaks; headroom is not an operational reserve.
The failed-point peak is memory observed before allocation failure, not the memory needed to complete it.
No new exact replay or dense-teacher numerical gate at the near-limit point; eight finite transitions and clean teardown are the new gates.
Replay harness seeds decode with the last prompt token; not a natural-response task test.
Fresh-process OOM/backoff only; same-process allocation-failure recovery is not qualified.
DMS INT8 stays explicit offline evaluation; no production-serving promotion, throughput claim or change to dense boundaries.
